reported.title: No hysteresis on FILL entry threshold
reported.description: FILL is entered whenever level < 10.0 cm, but the probe reading near the threshold will oscillate the state between IDLE and FILL on noise, toggling the valve rapidly; a small hysteresis band (e.g. enter FILL below 9.5 cm, exit only above 10.5 cm) is needed.

reported.title: Reset not applied immediately
reported.description: The reset button is only sampled inside the 40 ms tick block, so holding D4 LOW does not force IDLE 'immediately' and outputs can stay energized up to ~40 ms plus loop jitter; reset should be checked every loop iteration and drive outputs right away.

reported.title: Motor cutoff latency not guaranteed
reported.description: The 600 ms motor-off requirement is met only because the tick is 40 ms, but the level is sampled and the state machine evaluated only once per tick; combined with the reset check being inside the same block, a slow analogRead or serial blocking can push the motor-off past 600 ms. Sampling and output update should be decoupled from the status print and reset handled first.

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A0 at 10 mV/cm; fill valve on D9; drum motor on D10; reset on D4 (pull-up).
- States: IDLE (both outputs OFF), FILL (valve D9 HIGH until level >= 25.0 cm), RUN (motor D10 HIGH while level stays >= 20.0 cm), then IDLE.
- Leave RUN and return to IDLE when level drops below 20.0 cm; motor D10 must go LOW within 600 ms.
- Enter FILL from IDLE when level is below 10.0 cm.
- Holding D4 LOW forces IDLE immediately.
- Print `laundry st=<0|1|2> cm=<n>` every 1000 ms.
